title: innodb_parallel_read_threads>1 makes simple select count more expensive
review_reason: Performance issue requires sysbench 1.0.20 data generation (10M rows, ~2 GiB file), cold buffer pool and repeated parallel_read_threads timings/IO measurements. Dataset plus InnoDB files exceeds current 2 GiB per-case budget, and 2 CPU cap cannot reproduce 8-thread hardware conditions; no wall-time oracle frozen.
